text: {"name":"wlc_sta_lookup_current_bss","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Returns the station matching the supplied address in the current BSS, invoking the station-index helper when the BSS record field at offset 72 is set and otherwise queuing a two-byte message.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"a1":"sta_addr","v1":"global_context","v2":"bss_entry","v4":"message_payload"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"current BSS index in the global context"},{"offset":72,"meaning":"field that selects the station-index helper or message-queue path"},{"offset":107,"meaning":"byte copied into the queued message payload"}]}
